title: Pagination
description: Keyset pagination for list queries. A list query's `params` include `limit` and `cursor`; its `result` holds `items` and `next_cursor`. Each list documents its sort order, always ending in the resource ID as a tie-breaker. A cursor is opaque, bound to the filters it was issued with (reusing it with different filters is INVALID_CURSOR) and valid for at least 24 hours. Records that change between pages are neither repeated nor skipped unless their sort key or filter membership changed; records created after the first page appear only if they sort after the cursor.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 50; at most 200.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; omitted or null for the first page.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page.
